# Kybrium

> Kybrium is a UK software studio building web platforms, internal tools, and automation for small and mid-sized businesses. Fixed-price, end-to-end, based in Cambridgeshire, England. Trading name of Cherya Holdings Limited (UK company number 17203315).

## What we do

We focus on five buckets of work, with depth in sales/ops automation and database-heavy applications:

- **Web platforms and websites** — marketing sites, landing pages, marketplaces, multi-tenant web apps, custom dashboards and admin interfaces
- **Internal tools and automation** — custom CRMs, stock control, fleet/driver tracking, scheduling, form builders, workflow automation across Microsoft 365, RingCentral, and existing CRMs
- **Database-heavy applications** — systems where data integrity, reporting, and scale matter, built with healthcare-grade habits
- **Hosting, maintenance, SEO** — ongoing maintenance and on-page SEO for sites we build or inherit
- **Mobile app advisory** — App Store / Play Store submission strategy and review-requirements advice (we do not publish to stores on behalf of clients)

## Who we are for

UK small-to-mid-sized businesses (10–200 employees) — operations directors, founders, and ops/sales managers evaluating whether to trust a small studio with real money. Technically literate but time-poor. Not developers themselves.

## How we work

- Fixed prices, quoted per-project after a discovery call
- A small number of clients at a time
- End-to-end ownership — design, build, ship, maintain
- UK-based, supports UK businesses
- One business day reply on enquiries; fixed quote within a week of the discovery call
